bio.text: Josh Gottheimer represents New Jersey's 5th Congressional District, which includes parts of Bergen, Passaic and Sussex counties.
He was first sworn in on January 3, 2017, and is in his fifth term.
Before Congress he worked at Microsoft as General Manager for Corporate Strategy.
He graduated from West Essex High School, attended the University of Pennsylvania, was a Thouron Fellow at Oxford, and attended Harvard Law School.
